title: apache/commons-numbers#223: ArithmeticUtils.pow accepts (-2)^31, found and confined from bytecode
summary: A pull request that lets `ArithmeticUtils.pow(int, int)` return `Integer.MIN_VALUE` for `(-2)^31` instead of throwing. The regression proof found the one changed input, `pow(-2, 31)`, from the two versions' bytecode in 185 s; the Javadoc was proved on the new version; and the change was proved confined to that input on all 2^64 others in 18 minutes.
verdictLabel: ✗ the intended change found; ✓ confined to it; ✓ Javadoc proved
notes: Next: `pow(long, int)`, which the same pull request changed and the recorded run did not reach.
The confined-change proof did not finish in the default 300 s and took 1083 s with `--timeout 1500`: budget proofs over two full `int` ranges in tens of minutes.
provenance: A real change to a published library, verified with the /verify-bytecode skill; the report is this folder's README.md.
